name: item
title: Item
description: List rows on shared keylines: media cell, content, meta and action cells; render-prop rows for links and buttons.
whenToUse: Use it for lists of rows with media, content, a value and controls, where a row may be a link or a button. For tabular data with columns use Table.

parts.name: Item
parts.description: One row: media/code cell · content · meta · actions. Pass `render={<a href="…" />}` or `render={<button />}` to make the whole row the interactive element; props, refs and handlers merge through Base UI's useRender, as in every Base UI part.

props.name: current
props.description: Marks the row as the current location (master–detail): its leading cell floods with the commit signal.

parts.name: ItemActions
parts.description: Trailing controls. Cells (Button layout="cell") share the row's keylines; a Switch or Badge sits centred.

parts.name: ItemContent
parts.description: The row's words: its title, an optional description, and any children under them.

props.name: description
props.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Promise<AwaitedReactNode>

props.name: title
props.type: string | number | bigint | boolean | ReactElement<unknown, string | JSXElementConstructor<any>> | Iterable<ReactNode> | ReactPortal | Promise<AwaitedReactNode>

parts.name: ItemList
parts.description: A list of rows on shared keylines: settings, members, files, integrations. As a standalone region it is a 3px frame; with layout="cell" it is the body of an enclosing frame (a Panel body with `flush`).

parts.name: ItemMedia
parts.description: Leading cell: a 16px icon, an initial, or a code of up to four mono characters (ERP, DHL). Square and fixed, so the content seam lines up down the list; floods when the row is current. Longer values (times, IDs) belong in ItemMeta or the description, never here.

parts.name: ItemMeta
parts.description: Trailing value in the Code voice (a size, a date, a count). Tabular, right-aligned.
